findingClass: mixed-clock-ordering (F-210): a timestamp-named key (`fooAt` / `timestamp`) assigned the app host clock (`new Date()`) in shared admin / repository / service code or a web admin API route, where the stored time may be ordered against a database-stamped time (documents.created_at, data_conflicts.detected_at, any defaultNow() column), so drift between the two clocks silently misorders events (docs/reviews/failure-classes/mixed-clock-ordering.json).
failThreshold: scripts/ci/check-app-clock-timestamps.mjs exits 1 on any occurrence of `<name>At: new Date()` or `timestamp: new Date()` (with or without a trailing .toISOString()) in packages/shared/src/services, packages/shared/src/repositories, packages/shared/src/admin or web/app/api/admin (tests excluded, comment lines ignored) that is neither covered by scripts/ci/app-clock-timestamps-baseline.json (keyed file + line text, with a count, so a line shift does not re-fail and one more identical line does) nor marked `// app-clock-ok: <reason>` on the same or previous line. A baseline entry without a reason of 10+ characters also fails. It names file:line of every new offender.
unverifiableWhen: n/a — a CI gate, not a nightly audit check; it runs on every PR through the pr-gate `gate` job or not at all.
note: IMPLEMENTED 2026-09-29 (PR #1309). Self-test scripts/ci/tests/check-app-clock-timestamps.test.mjs (7 cases): red on a planted `detectedAt: new Date()` in a scanned tree (names file:line) and on `timestamp: new Date().toISOString()` in a web admin route, red when a baselined line appears one more time than its count and when a baseline entry has no reason; green on sql`now()`, a marked line, a comment, an unscanned tree, and the real tree. Verified on the real tree: planting `detectedAt: new Date()` back at data-conflicts-repository.ts:175 exits 1 naming that line. Known gaps: a key not ending in `At` / not named `timestamp`, a `new Date()` held in a variable first, and trees outside the four scanned (scraper/src) are not caught. Baseline: 22 occurrences (updated_at bookkeeping read only in hours-wide freshness windows, a Redis score, API response metadata), each with its reason; it may only shrink.
owner: Landed 2026-09-29. Consumer: the PR gate (`gate` job, .github/workflows/pr-gate.yml).
